Name: Ridgeside Village-June's Portraiture
Author: qingqingzijinyywx
Description:
[color=#ff7700]此mod为里奇赛德村可婚角色June的高清肖像，我想使其看起来更加温柔儒雅，所以制作了此肖像，希望大家也能喜欢。
[/color]
This mod is a HD portrait of June, a marriable character from Ridgeside Village. I wanted to make him look more gentle , so I made this portrait, I hope you will enjoy it.


安装本mod前需要下载两个前置mod才能正常使用
1.Portraiture
2.smapi

Before installing this mod, you need to download two pre-installed mods
1.Portraiture
2.smapi


[color=#ffff00][b]如果不显示肖像怎么办？[/b][/color]：
     首先进入游戏与June对话，在对话时按字母P键切换肖像，切换到需要的肖像后按字母O键锁定，肖像就固定好了。
      如需切换其他模组的肖像，再次按O键解锁，P键切换就可以了。

What if the portrait is not displayed? :
First of all, enter the game and talk with June. During the conversation, press the keyboard P key to switch the portrait. After switching to the required portrait, press the keyboard O key to lock it, and the portrait will be fixed.
If you need to switch the portrait of other modules, press the O key again to unlock, and the P key can switch.
